answer: Panel pair cool-down: any two graders may share a 7-seat panel at most once per 10-epoch window; the draw skips pairs on the dune, a rolling table of used pairs. Seating 4 members of ring Violet burns 6 of its m(m-1)/2 pairs, so m accounts capture at most m(m-1)/12 panels per window (K8 packs only 2 disjoint 4-sets); 20 captures need m>=16, i.e. 16 established wallets at price c each. Weakness: waiting 10 epochs clears the table, so a patient ring of m=4 still takes one panel per window, and a meadow of idle established wallets is the cheapest supply.
